parsed.explanation: No trans-specific criminal ban, border/facility/care restriction, or documented police campaign against trans visitors; sexuality law is secondary. Still, if outed, consequences are severe: official anti-trans rhetoric, absence of gender-identity protection/recourse, condemnation of cross-dressing, underground LGBT scene, and documented anti-LGBT visitor violence with judicial gay-panic tolerance/unsolved murders signal weak protection. Data thin, so not 0.15-tier; but institutionalized targeting/active enforcement absent, placing it at lower High Risk/Elevated boundary around 0.35.
